messages:
sam: deploy-bot just flagged p95 on /v1/embeds-eu during the change window, canary at 10% — starting quick verification.

deploy-bot: [automated] preflight ok; canary=10%; p95=285ms (SLO=200ms); err_rate=0.42% :warning:

mira: seeing a spike in 502/504s on embeds-eu around the same time, linking dashboard -> https://obs/redwood/d/embeds-eu :eyes:

jonathan: can we pause traffic shift and pin to previous model variant for the embed route? not comfortable with p95 this high mid-rollout.

priya: agree — policy is pause if p95 > SLO for >5m or if error_budget_drain >2%. what's the current window duration?

sre-bot: alert: SLO_violation(embed-eu).p95 > 200ms for 6m; error_budget_drain=3.4%. Notified oncall.

alex: i'll prepare a quick rollback/pin. recommend pinning route to v2.4.0-legacy-quant until we debug.

sam: please run release-bot rollback for the embed route and halt the canary shift.

release-bot: received: rollback request queued. executing rollback to v2.4.0-legacy-quant for route embeds-eu (scope: canary+10%). ETA ~2m.

mira: observability note — prefix cache miss ratio jumped to 18% (baseline ~3%), could be KV cache warmup + quant path behavior. logs: `cache_miss_ratio=0.18 host=embed-rt-7`

jonathan: added a temporary routing override to pin high-value customers to stable. snippet: `route.rules["enterprise"]=version:v2.4.0`

priya: monitoring: i'll watch p95 and 5xx for next 10m and post updates here. also tagging oncall-alerts. :mag:

release-bot: rollback complete, traffic back to v2.4.0-legacy-quant, canary halted. commit: deploy-2026-03-21-rollback-6578901234

alex: verified traffic shift, health probes green across region.

sam: SLO quick-check: p95=170ms, 5xx back to baseline. closing loop for now, will add a short blameless note to the release doc and follow up with post-deploy debug for cache/quant interactions. :thumbsup:

mira: leaving a TODO to run a controlled bench with quant profiles tomorrow morning.

jonathan: thanks everyone — marking deploy window as "paused" and creating follow-up ticket.

priya: will keep monitoring alerts. ping me if it flares back up.

sam: thanks — nice quick coordination.
